preconditions.description: The input list must contain at least one number.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) for n in numbers)
preconditions.description: All elements in the input list must be integers.

postconditions.description: The result is one of the numbers in the input list.

postconditions.expression: all(find_longest(numbers) == max(numbers, key=lambda x: len(str(x))) for numbers in ([1], [1, 10], [10, 100], [100, 1000], [-1, -10, -100]))
postconditions.description: The function correctly identifies the number with the most digits, or the first one in case of a tie.
